metadata.title: Localization in Seven-Dimensional Supergravity
metadata.abstract: Seven-dimensional supergravity provides holographic access to strongly coupled six-dimensional superconformal theories through its highest-dimensional supersymmetric AdS vacua. Its unique spinor-bilinear geometry and massive higher-form dynamics make systematic analysis and solution-finding distinctively challenging. Relative equivariant localization can obtain supersymmetric observables in odd dimensions from fixed-point data on an auxiliary even-dimensional filling, without an explicit solution. We extend this approach to seven dimensions in maximal Cartan-gauged supergravity with all gauge fields active. We formulate the Euclidean action and Killing-spinor equations in terms of field strengths, and construct a bilinear system adapted to the change in spinor reality conditions from symplectic-Majorana to Majorana. On the non-null gauged active spinor branch, independent, oppositely R-charged spinors are paired by Majorana conjugation on the same complex background. One algebraic gauging correction and two algebraic bilinear projections suffice to extend the equal-charge sector to independent Cartan charges, and the underlying efficient reorganization also applies in the Lorentzian theory. Massive 3-form self-duality fixes the quartic anomaly class and determines the higher-form fixed-point datum from Abelian moment maps. Localization at the single fixed point of the filling recovers the general supersymmetric AdS$_7$ black-hole action, without extending the solution. We prove gauge-covariant Killing-spinor invariance under the combined supersymmetric Killing flow and R-symmetry action, deriving the linear chemical-potential constraint. Extremizing the constrained entropy functional and requiring real positive stationary entropy yields the nonlinear charge relation within the Euclidean analysis, equivalent to Lorentzian horizon extremality for the known spherical black-hole family.

analysis.progressType: 七维超引力的等变局部化
analysis.workSummary: 在所有规范场均激活的七维 maximal Cartan-gauged 超引力中扩展相对等变局部化，利用辅助偶维 filling 的固定点数据计算超对称观测量。建立适配 Euclid spinor 实性条件的双线性系统，利用 massive 三形式自对偶确定四次反常类及高阶场固定点数据，并恢复一般超对称 AdS₇ 黑洞作用量。
techniques: Killing spinor 双线性与 Majorana 共轭
analysis.breakthrough: 无需显式延拓解即可从单固定点数据得到作用量，并在所述分支导出化学势线性约束及电荷非线性关系。
analysis.limitations: 非零范数的 gauged active spinor 分支与全部双线性投影条件不可略去；电荷关系与 Lorentz 极端视界的等价针对已知球形黑洞族，不是全部七维黑洞分类。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。实际PDF SHA-256匹配，38页完整提取且无短文本页。第5、23页AI是带指标I的Abelian规范势A^I数学记号（I=1,2），并非人工智能；补充点写AI、断行/连字符模型名与Danus等无作者自身使用披露。

analysis.priorityReason: 偏超引力与高能数学物理，几何工具丰富但与曲率比较/几何 PDE 的直接阅读目标较远。
